Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Temporary accelerator assignment + burst buffer for launch week

Hi Evelyn,

Quick note from our side as we ramp toward our v1 launch the week of Feb 6: our performance team is asking whether Redwood can provide a temporary assignment of a higher-bandwidth accelerator (H100-class) to a subset of our Dedicated pool for three days around launch and an "elastic burst buffer" that absorbs short-term peak token throughput without triggering unlimited overages.

We understand this is nonstandard; Sentinel is prepared to commit to a 6-month Dedicated contract (baseline committed hours) and prepay the first month if that helps. Our asks:
- Temporary mapping of up to 4x H100-equivalent accelerators to our reserved capacity for 72 hours (Feb 7–9)
- An elastic burst allowance up to 120 GPU-hours across those days, billed at a capped overage rate rather than go-to-list price
- A short amendment to the SOW and a DocuSign-ready amendment we can sign by Jan 20

I attached a brief requirements doc and our expected concurrency curve. Can we get a ballpark on cost for the buffer and confirmation this is something Redwood can do operationally?

Thanks,
Jason Howard
VP Engineering | Sentinel AI
ops@sentinel.ai

Attachments: sentinel_launch_requirements.pdf (pdf)

Jason —

Thanks for the clear ask and the attachment. Short answer: we can operationally map higher-bandwidth accelerators for short windows and offer a capped-billing burst allowance, but it needs Deal Desk approval for the nonstandard GPU assignment and an overage-rate cap.

Next steps I propose:
1) I'll open an internal escalation with the Deal Desk and include cost math.
2) We can draft an amendment that defines the 72-hour window, the maximum burst hours (120), the capped overage rate, and a fallback to the default model type outside the window.
3) If you can confirm the exact UTC window for Feb 7–9 and whether you want the burst to be applied per-cluster or across the whole reservation, we'll include that in the SOW.

I'll loop in Aditya for commercial alignment.

Cheers,
